about: Events with no all-stages medal whose rerun is ticked when the account owns this operator (lib/pulls/schedule.ts rerunClearOperator). Keyed as data/rerun-clear-medals.json is (act24side -> 24side). Owning the event's operator is taken as having cleared it: the owner's call (2026-10-28), since counting a cleared rerun's Originite twice overstates pulls, and leaving out an uncleared one only understates them.
